description: This file defines the HistoryInterface in PHP, which specifies methods for managing and accessing a history or undo/redo stack related to layout or interface states within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: HistoryInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for retrieving and managing historical interface states, including getting the first, next, and nth items, restoring by timestamp, undoing restores, and appending new items to the history.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Returns the ID of the most recent item in the history.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the ID of the next oldest item in the history.

methods.name: getNth
methods.description: Returns the ID of the nth item in the history, where zeroeth is the most recent.

methods.name: restoreByTimestamp
methods.description: Restores the layout identified by the given timestamp, returns the timestamp if successful or null on failure.

methods.name: undoRestore
methods.description: Reverts the last restore, returning to the previous layout state.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new item to the history with the specified path, returning a timestamp for the new item.
